patthana15.11:1.1: Hetuṃ sekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu nasekkho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana15.11:2.1: Hetuṃ asekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu naasekkho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana15.11:3.1: Nahetuṃ nevasekkhanāsekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nanahetu nanevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
